test_title: PYST 39: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 21 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A and B complete a work in 20 days. If A alone can do it in 45 days, then B alone can do one-third of the same work in _______ days.
solution:
**Given:**

A + B finish work in 20 days

A alone finishes in 45 days

**Calculation:**

Total work = LCM(20, 45) = 180 units

Efficiency(A + B) = 180 ÷ 20 = 9 units/day

Efficiency(A) = 180 ÷ 45 = 4 units/day

Efficiency(B) = 9 − 4 = 5 units/day

B’s one-third work = 180 ÷ 3 = 60 units

Time taken = 60 ÷ 5 = 12 days

**∴ B alone can do one-third of work in 12 days.**
